title: Taking Away
short: Subtracting means taking some away and counting what is left.
trouble: Children count the objects taken away as the answer instead of the ones left.

blocks.html: When some things go away, the group gets smaller. That is taking away, or subtracting. It undoes putting together.

blocks.name: k-pic
blocks.cap: 6 cookies. 2 were eaten, so they are crossed out. 4 are left.

blocks.html: To take away, start with the whole group, remove some, and count what is left. We write $6 - 2 = 4$ and say “6 minus 2 equals 4.”
The ones taken away are gone. Only the ones that stay are left to count.

blocks.title: Birds fly away
blocks.q: There are 7 birds. 3 fly away. How many are left?

blocks.html: Counting the ones taken away instead of the ones left. The question asks what is left. Check: the ones left and the ones taken away together make the whole group, 4 and 3 make 7.

blocks.name: tenframe

task.text: There are 8. Take away 3. Show what is left.

blocks.cap: Tap the counters to take some away.

blocks.html: For grown-ups: Act it out: 5 grapes, eat 2, how many left? Ask your child to tell the story with the words “take away” and “left.”
